name: PasswordInput
description: A password field with an animated eye toggle, a four-segment strength meter that springs and recolors as you type, and a rule checklist whose check marks draw themselves in as each requirement is met.
a11yNotes: Native <input type="password"> labelled by a visible <label>. The show/hide control is a native button with aria-pressed, aria-controls and a state-dependent aria-label (Show password / Hide password). The strength label is an aria-live polite region and, together with the rule list, is referenced by aria-describedby; each rule carries visually hidden '(met)' / '(not met)' text. The meter bars are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the meter and check marks update instantly.
